Description: Creates a new configuration item. Validates payload against JSON Schema (AJV). Requires 'code' field. Rejects duplicates. For 'category' type auto-creates links from array fields. Creates outbox event (Settings.Created) in transaction.
Authorization: JWT + RBAC via Access Management Service
Criticality Reason: Configuration items define business rules, product parameters, fee structures, and templates used across the platform. Incorrect or failed creation can leave downstream services without required configuration. Used by product, payment, and application services.
Important Log Fields: namespace, resource_type, code, schema_version, created_by, link_count (if category), trace_id, span_id
Sensitive Data: JWT token (contains identificationNumber, autenticatorQrCode, accountToken, phone, email). user.id stored as createdBy.
Dependencies: DB: SchemaRegistry.findOne, ConfigItem.findOne (dup check), ConfigItem.create, ConfigItem.findAll (link targets), ConfigLink.findAll, ConfigLink.bulkCreate, OutboxConfiguration.create — all in transaction. HTTP: Access Management Service (guard).
Existing Observability: SDK ObservabilityLogger: controller-level info/error with traceId/spanId/userId. SDK auto HTTP spans.
Observability Gap: No custom metrics. No domain event (only outbox for Kafka). Controller logging is present but service-level business logic has no structured logging. Schema validation failures logged only as generic errors.
Notes: Best-instrumented service in fleet for logging. Gap is custom metrics and domain events.

Description: Updates a configuration item payload. Rejects immutable fields (code). Validates partial payload against schema (AJV with required removed). Separates link fields from data fields. For 'category' type auto-creates new links. Merges payloads. Creates outbox event (Settings.Updated).
Criticality Reason: Configuration updates change live business rules. Incorrect updates can break product pricing, fee calculations, or workflow templates across the platform. Optimistic concurrency via rowVersion protects against conflicts.
Important Log Fields: namespace, resource_type, code, updated_fields[], version, updated_by, trace_id, span_id
Sensitive Data: JWT token. user.id used for link creation.
Dependencies: DB: SchemaRegistry.findOne, ConfigItem.findOne, ConfigItem.save, ConfigLink.findAll, ConfigLink.bulkCreate, OutboxConfiguration.create — transaction. HTTP: Access Management Service.
Existing Observability: SDK ObservabilityLogger at controller level. SDK auto HTTP spans.
Observability Gap: No custom metrics. No domain event. Optimistic concurrency conflicts not specifically logged. Updated fields not tracked.
Notes: Should log which fields changed (before/after diff) for audit trail. Optimistic concurrency (rowVersion) conflicts should emit a specific warning.

Criticality Reason: Deleting configuration items removes business rules from the platform. Soft-delete allows recovery but downstream services may immediately lose access to the config. Needs audit trail.
Important Log Fields: namespace, resource_type, code, deleted_by, trace_id, span_id
Dependencies: DB: SchemaRegistry.findOne, ConfigItem.findOne, ConfigItem.save, OutboxConfiguration.create — transaction. HTTP: Access Management Service.
Existing Observability: SDK ObservabilityLogger at controller level. **console.log('Deleting config item:' configItem) on line 1025 of configuration.service.ts — leaks full config item to stdout.**
Observability Gap: console.log leaking full config item object. No custom metrics. No domain event. The console.log is a data leak — config items may contain sensitive business rules, templates, or fee structures.
Notes: SECURITY: Remove console.log on line 1025 that dumps full config item object. Replace with structured SDK log with just namespace/type/code.

Description: Creates a link between two configuration items. Validates both source and target exist. Rejects duplicate active links. Creates ConfigLink record + outbox event (Settings.Created). Emits configuration.created EventEmitter2 event.
Criticality Reason: Links define relationships between configuration items (e.g., product-to-category, bundle-to-product). Important for data integrity but failure affects only the specific link being created, not existing config.
Important Log Fields: namespace, relation, from_code, to_code, created_by, trace_id
Sensitive Data: JWT token. user.id stored in createdBy.
Dependencies: DB: SchemaRegistry.findOne x2, ConfigItem.findOne x2, ConfigLink.findOne (dup check), ConfigLink.create, OutboxConfiguration.create — transaction. HTTP: Access Management Service. EventEmitter2.
Existing Observability: SDK ObservabilityLogger at controller level. SDK auto HTTP spans.
Observability Gap: No custom metrics. No domain event beyond outbox.

Important Log Fields: namespace, relation, from_code, to_code, deleted_by, trace_id

Important Log Fields: schema_id, namespace, resource_type, schema_version, compat_mode, status, created_by, trace_id
Sensitive Data: JWT token. user.id stored as createdBy.
Dependencies: DB: SchemaRegistry.create — transaction. HTTP: Access Management Service.
Existing Observability: SDK ObservabilityLogger at controller level. **console.log('Transaction rolled back') and console.error('Error rolling back transaction:') in service error handling.**
Observability Gap: console.log/error in error path. No custom metrics. No domain event. POTENTIAL ROUTE CONFLICT: POST /schema may be captured by POST /:ns/:type with ns='schema' — depends on NestJS decorator order.
Notes: ROUTE CONFLICT WARNING: POST /api/configuration/v1/schema is declared AFTER POST /api/configuration/v1/:ns/:type in the controller. NestJS route resolution may match /:ns/:type first with ns='schema'. Verify this works correctly. Remove console.log/error in error handling.
